cmd:
set -euo pipefail
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends openssh-client
rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
TUNNEL_DIR=$(mktemp -d /tmp/aividup-tunnel.XXXXXXXX)
chmod 0700 "$TUNNEL_DIR"
printf '%s' "$AIVIDUP_TUNNEL_PRIVATE_KEY_B64" | base64 --decode > "$TUNNEL_DIR/id_ed25519"
chmod 0600 "$TUNNEL_DIR/id_ed25519"
printf '%s\n' "$AIVIDUP_TUNNEL_HOST_KEY" > "$TUNNEL_DIR/known_hosts"
chmod 0600 "$TUNNEL_DIR/known_hosts"
/usr/bin/ssh -N -L 127.0.0.1:18099:127.0.0.1:8099 -i "$TUNNEL_DIR/id_ed25519" -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=15 -o ExitOnForwardFailure=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o UserKnownHostsFile="$TUNNEL_DIR/known_hosts" -o GlobalKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o ServerAliveInterval=10 -o ServerAliveCountMax=3 aividup-pilot-tunnel@195.234.126.233 &
TUNNEL_PID=$!
WORKER_PID=''
cleanup() { rc=$?; trap - EXIT INT TERM; if [ -n "$WORKER_PID" ]; then kill "$WORKER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$WORKER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; kill "$TUNNEL_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$TUNNEL_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; rm -rf "$TUNNEL_DIR"; exit "$rc"; }
trap cleanup EXIT
trap 'exit 143' INT TERM
READY=0
for attempt in $(seq 1 30); do
  if (exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/18099) 2>/dev/null; then READY=1; break; fi
  kill -0 "$TUNNEL_PID" 2>/dev/null || { wait "$TUNNEL_PID"; exit 1; }
  sleep 1
done
[ "$READY" = 1 ] || { echo 'SSH tunnel did not become ready' >&2; exit 1; }
unset AIVIDUP_TUNNEL_PRIVATE_KEY_B64 AIVIDUP_TUNNEL_HOST_KEY
/usr/bin/python3 /opt/aividup-runpod-pilot/runpod_checkpoint_bootstrap.py &
WORKER_PID=$!
wait "$WORKER_PID"
